objective: Make the race the acquisition and winback engine of the month (teams of two = pure acquisition), and carry July starters into September with a 57-day ticket.
strategy:
The Amazing Race 2.0.

Commercial job: Make the race the acquisition and winback engine of the month (teams of two = pure acquisition), and carry July starters into September with a 57-day ticket.

Newcomer: Starting Gun Week (“Race week, open to all. Buy your first month and run it.”). The race is the biggest social asset of the year; opening a week of it to non-members converts spectators.

Newcomer: Tag Team (“Two people. One price. Race-ready.”). Teams of two are the race format, so the pair offer is the natural conversion: both must be new, both must buy.

Winback: Back on Track (“Your team saved your spot. 20% off to take it.”). A team story is a better reason to return than a discount; the bonus pays for attendance, not the purchase.

Renewal: Victory Lap (“Win or lose, you get a victory lap: 20% off 3 months.”). Races are inherently motivating; converting the high (finishers and near-missers) into a 3-month commitment is the cheapest retention there is.
notes:
Moment: Amazing Race 2.0 finale Fri 8–Sat 9 Aug at Kwality: teams of 2 run a class circuit, relay-format heats by age group, medal ceremony and after-party.
Build: new clients 84 buyers = ₹6.0L; reactivation 35 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.8L; renewals ₹25.2L. First visits needed 186; CRM leads needed 232.

items.detail: Set up Starting Gun Week in Momence (1–9 Aug.): Any first class free during race week — buy within 72 hours for 20% off 1 Month (₹16,191).
Set up Tag Team in Momence (1–31 Aug.): Two new people, one 12-class pack at 20% off (₹15,750), shared between them.
Set up Back on Track in Momence (All Aug.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) — a race team entry and 2 bonus classes.
Set up Victory Lap in Momence (All Aug.): 3 Months Unlimited at 20% off (₹46,284) — a finisher's medal and 2 bonus classes.
Brief the team on the 4 August offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Starting Gun Week to First-time clients.
Launch Tag Team to Two first-timers in a race team.
Launch Back on Track to Lapsed clients.
Launch Victory Lap to Members renewing in August.
Run the month's moment: Amazing Race 2.0 finale Fri 8–Sat 9 Aug at Kwality: teams of 2 run a class circuit, relay-format heats by age group, medal ceremony and after-party.

Weekly check: Starting Gun Week: Race-week first classes; 72-hour conversion. | Tag Team: Pairs registered; both-buy rate. | Back on Track: Lapsed purchases; bonus class usage. | Victory Lap: Finishers renewing; 3M share.
Mid-month review against ₹39.0L: by the 15th aim for about half of 226 renewals, 36 reactivations and 84 new buyers (280 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close August: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief September's offers.
